options.label: Preserve R0 and collect canonical R1
options.effect: Keep R0 immutable for audit and later perform a separately authorized fresh collection directly into the exact Phase -1 v1alpha1 shape.

options.label: Stale mapping projection only
options.effect: Create a non-runnable mapping fixture from R0 with unknown fields; useful for contract tests but never freshness or admission evidence.

options.label: Extend historical R0 shape
options.effect: Add fields to the P3.6 shape, creating a competing platform contract; rejected by the Phase -1 authority partition.

options.label: Defer
options.effect: Keep the portable profile ineligible and stop R1 authorization preparation.

options.label: 24-hour maximum plus change invalidation
options.effect: Set valid_until no later than 24 hours after observation and invalidate sooner after authorized hardware, OS, driver, runtime, collector, or trust-policy change. This is an H-CAM lab policy, not a NIST mandate.

options.label: 8-hour session window
options.effect: Require recollection per work session or shift; strongest freshness with higher collection friction.

options.label: 7-day maximum
options.effect: Reduce collection friction but permit materially older compatibility evidence; not recommended for changing developer machines.

options.label: Custom owner duration
options.effect: Owner supplies a positive duration and invalidation triggers before an R1 authorization packet can be sealed.

options.label: Observed local generated-only zone
options.effect: Use local_read_only plus observed provenance for R1 and bind placement later to a separately accepted opaque digest for an owned-local, generated-only, no-external-data policy snapshot.

options.label: Owner-supplied declared evidence
options.effect: Accept declared provenance for planning, but prohibit automatic admission until independently observed or attested evidence exists.

options.label: Attested enterprise evidence
options.effect: Require a future approved attestation provider; stronger production direction but unavailable for the current laptop and unauthorized now.

options.label: Defer trust binding
options.effect: Leave trust unresolved and keep every placement and activation path blocked.

options.label: Block new admission and preserve lease authority
options.effect: Expired inventory blocks new resolution and placement; derived decisions cannot outlive inputs; already admitted work follows its independent lease, fencing, health, and policy rules without automatic trust extension.

options.label: Immediate safe pause
options.effect: Pause active work as soon as inventory expires; strongest fail-closed behavior but may interrupt valid leased work for a static-inventory refresh delay.

options.label: Bounded grace window
options.effect: Allow a short owner-defined grace period; adds policy complexity and permits admission decisions based on expired evidence, so it is not recommended.

options.label: Custom reconciliation
options.effect: Owner supplies exact new-admission and active-lease behavior before an R1 authorization packet is prepared.
